name: WANTED: Bruuz
summary: Bruuz threatens the harbor traffic that keeps Ratchet busy. Gazlowe has posted a bounty for the huge shark prowling the docks and disrupting coastal trade.

sections.title: A Terror in the Bay
sections.body: Ratchet is the primary neutral gateway between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, and its trade depends on merchant ships. Lately, a huge shark called Bruuz has been prowling the bay. Dockworkers gave the shark its name after it began attacking small skiffs, sailors, and cargo being unloaded near the docks. Its presence disrupts the port and puts the ships that keep Ratchet supplied at risk.

sections.title: Gazlowe's Bounty
sections.body: Gazlowe has posted a public bounty to keep ships from avoiding his port for fear of the shark. The notice calls on anglers and promises a hefty reward. To claim it, you need to slay Bruuz and bring back the shark's dorsal fin as proof.

faq.answer: Bruuz is a huge, aggressive shark hunting near Ratchet's shipping docks. Dockworkers gave it that name after attacks on sailors and small vessels.

faq.q: Why did Gazlowe post a bounty on Bruuz?
faq.answer: Bruuz disrupts the shipping and trade that fuel Ratchet's economy. Gazlowe offers a cash reward for the shark's carcass to protect business at the docks.
Bruuz prowls the waters off Ratchet in the Barrens, often near the main shipping piers and harbor entrance.

faq.q: What proof does Gazlowe require for the kill?
faq.answer: Gazlowe requires Bruuz's dorsal fin as proof that the shark has been slain before he pays the bounty.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde adventurers take this bounty?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is run by the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, and Gazlowe welcomes capable adventurers from either faction to deal with the shark.

faq.q: Why does the bounty specifically call for anglers?
faq.answer: The notice does not explain why it calls for anglers. It opens with “Calling all anglers!” and promises a hefty reward for Bruuz's fin.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can test your patience and aim against Bruuz, a huge predator of the waters.
As a cook, you could make use of the fresh coastal meat from a shark as large as Bruuz. Gazlowe wants only the dorsal fin as proof of the kill.
